entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hello Diana. I'm calling about my new VeloBand GPS Tracker. I got it as a gift for Christmas, so I've had it for about 20 days, and the pulse reader is just not working.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a technical fault. The heart rate data won't sync to the app no matter what I do. I've tried everything in the manual, and I'm starting to think the sensor itself is broken.
I see. It sounds like the device you received might be defective. I can definitely look into your options. Can I get the order number or the email address associated with the purchase?

Sure, the email is example@email.com. Before you look, I just want to be clear, if a full return isn't an option because of the time, would a partial credit be on the table? I'm happy to find a solution that works for both of us.
I appreciate that. Let me just pull up the policy here... one moment. Okay, I've got your order details. It looks like you're well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, 90 days? That's fantastic. I thought it might be shorter.

Not at all. Since it's only been 20 days and you're reporting a defective unit, we can absolutely process a full return for you. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label to send to your email right now.
Wow, that was much easier than I anticipated. Thank you so much for the quick help, Diana.

You're very welcome. Just package the VeloBand back in its original box, attach that label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to the original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
